ayahs.tj: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا ١
ayahs.en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

ayahs.tj: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا ٢
ayahs.en: And the winds that blow violently

ayahs.tj: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٲتِ نَشْرًا ٣
ayahs.en: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

ayahs.tj: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا ٤
ayahs.en: And those [angels] who bring criterion

ayahs.tj: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا ٥
ayahs.en: And those [angels] who deliver a message

ayahs.tj: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا ٦
ayahs.en: As justification or warning,

ayahs.tj: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٲقِعٌ ٧
ayahs.en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

ayahs.tj: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ ٨
ayahs.en: So when the stars are obliterated

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ ٩
ayahs.en: And when the heaven is opened

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ ١٠
ayahs.en: And when the mountains are blown away

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ ١١
ayahs.en: And when the messengers' time has come...

ayahs.tj: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ ١٢
ayahs.en: For what Day was it postponed?

ayahs.tj: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ ١٣
ayahs.en: For the Day of Judgement.

ayahs.tj: وَمَآ أَدْرَٮٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ١٤
ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ١٥
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ١٦
ayahs.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْأَخِرِينَ ١٧
ayahs.en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

ayahs.tj: كَذَٲلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ١٨
ayahs.en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ١٩
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ ٢٠
ayahs.en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

ayahs.tj: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ ٢١
ayahs.en: And We placed it in a firm lodging

ayahs.tj: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ ٢٢
ayahs.en: For a known extent.

ayahs.tj: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ ٢٣
ayahs.en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٢٤
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا ٢٥
ayahs.en: Have We not made the earth a container

ayahs.tj: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٲتًا ٢٦
ayahs.en: Of the living and the dead?

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلنا فيها رَوٰسِىَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَأَسقَينٰكُم ماءً فُراتًا
ayahs.tj: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٲسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا ٢٧
ayahs.en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٢٨
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.ar: انطَلِقوا إِلىٰ ما كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
ayahs.tj: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ٢٩
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

ayahs.ar: انطَلِقوا إِلىٰ ظِلٍّ ذى ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍ
ayahs.tj: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ ٣٠
ayahs.en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

ayahs.ar: لا ظَليلٍ وَلا يُغنى مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
ayahs.tj: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ ٣١
ayahs.en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

ayahs.tj: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ ٣٢
ayahs.en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

ayahs.tj: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ ٣٣
ayahs.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٣٤
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ ٣٥
ayahs.en: This is a Day they will not speak,

ayahs.tj: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ ٣٦
ayahs.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٣٧
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ‌ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٣٨
ayahs.en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

ayahs.tj: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ ٣٩
ayahs.en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٠
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ ٤١
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

ayahs.tj: وَفَوَٲكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ ٤٢
ayahs.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

ayahs.ar: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
ayahs.tj: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـــَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ٤٣
ayahs.en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

ayahs.tj: إِنَّا كَذَٲلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ٤٤
ayahs.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٥
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ ٤٦
ayahs.en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٧
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.ar: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُمُ اركَعوا لا يَركَعونَ
ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُواْ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ ٤٨
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

ayahs.tj: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٤٩
ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

ayahs.tj: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ ٥٠
ayahs.en: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
